/story.title: Our story | Sahar
/story.description: A perfume house founded in Dubai in 2019 by perfumer Mariam Al Suwaidi.
h1: A perfume housefor the hour before dawn.
p: Founded in Dubai in 2019 by perfumer Mariam Al Suwaidi, with one oud and a small atelier in Al Quoz.
Mariam trained in Grasse and spent a decade composing for houses in Paris before coming home to Dubai. She still smells every batch before it is bottled.
Roses are distilled in Taif each April, frankincense comes from Dhofar, and oud is aged for at least three years before we use it. We blend in small batches in Dubai.
Each perfume rests for six weeks before it is filtered and bottled. Every bottle carries a batch number written by the person who filled it.
